perimeter.semantics: CAL FIRE final perimeter, not a time series

home.method: easternmost largest-component road node covered by the final Carr perimeter inside the controlled bounding box

safe.method: easternmost largest-component node outside the final perimeter and within the declared north-south band

claim_boundary: Routes are derived from 2018 TIGER/Line road geometry inside a declared controlled bounding box. The obstruction is selected algorithmically for mechanism identification and is not an observed Carr Fire road closure.
